conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hey! Can you book a dinner table tonight for the 5 of us (p1 — Nadia, Tom, Amara, Lena, and Ben)?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You are coordinating dinner for 5 friends (party p1): Nadia, Tom, Amara, Lena, and Ben. Do NOT volunteer dietary, budget, walking, or timing details unless the concierge asks. When the concierge asks about constraints, share ALL of them clearly in one reply: (1) Nadia is strictly vegan (plant-based only), (2) Tom has a hard $25/person max budget, (3) Amara is on crutches and can walk at most 10 minutes, (4) Ben has zero requirements, and (5) curveball — Lena just texted that her train is late so she cannot arrive before 19:45 (7:45 PM), and she needs the kitchen to still be taking orders when she arrives. Once the concierge books a valid table (such as Pho Saigon at 19:45) and confirms, thank them and finish.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hi! Looking to grab dinner tonight for 4 people (p2 — Sam, Lena, Tom, and Ben). Can you book us somewhere?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You are coordinating dinner for 4 friends (party p2): Sam, Lena, Tom, and Ben. Hold back restrictions until the concierge asks. When asked, share ALL of them clearly in one reply: (1) Sam has a shellfish allergy including sneaky fish sauce, (2) Tom has a strict $25/person max budget, (3) Lena cannot arrive before 19:45 (7:45 PM), and (4) Ben has no requirements (walking distance and spice are fine for this group). Once the concierge books a valid table (such as Curry House or Noodle Bar at 19:45) and confirms, thank them and finish.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Could you book an early-ish dinner tonight for 5 of us (p10 — Priya, Sam, Tom, Yuki, and Diego)?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You are coordinating dinner for 5 friends (party p10): Priya, Sam, Tom, Yuki, and Diego. Wait until the concierge asks about dietary/budget/timing needs before sharing them. When asked, share ALL of them clearly in one reply: (1) Priya has a severe nut allergy (epipen — no peanuts, cashews, or pine nuts), (2) Sam has a shellfish allergy including fish sauce, (3) Tom has a strict $25/person budget cap, (4) Diego cannot do spicy food unless spice/salsa is strictly on the side, and (5) Yuki has daycare pickup and MUST leave by 19:15 (7:15 PM), so the table must be seated by 18:30 or earlier for a 45-minute dinner. Once the concierge books a valid table (such as Taqueria Luna at 18:00 or 18:30) and confirms, thank them and finish.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hey there — need a table for 4 tonight (p16 — Priya, Tom, Amara, and Ben). Where should we go?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You are coordinating dinner for 4 friends (party p16): Priya, Tom, Amara, and Ben. Only reveal the group's constraints when the concierge asks. When asked, share ALL of them clearly in one reply: (1) Priya has a severe nut allergy (no peanuts, peanut oil, peanut sauce, cashews, or pine nuts), (2) Tom has a hard $25/person budget limit, (3) Amara is on crutches and can walk at most 10 minutes, and (4) Ben is free all evening with zero restrictions. Once the concierge books a valid table (such as Taqueria Luna) and confirms, thank them and finish.
